summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests YL242, given alone or with other drugs (pembrolizumab, or 5-FU and leucovorin), in people with advanced solid tumors. YL242 is given by intravenous (IV) infusion, with the first dose over about 90 minutes and later doses over about 60 minutes if no infusion reaction occurs; how often doses are given is not stated. The study's main stated aim is to evaluate safety and tolerability.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa YL242, administrado solo o con otros medicamentos (pembrolizumab, o 5-FU y leucovorina), en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados. YL242 se administra por infusión intravenosa (IV); la primera dosis dura unos 90 minutos y las siguientes unos 60 minutos si no hay reacción a la infusión, y la frecuencia de las dosis no se indica. El objetivo principal indicado en el estudio es evaluar la seguridad y la tolerabilidad.
who_for: Adequate organ and bone marrow function.
Advanced or metastatic solid tumor; for most parts, at least one prior line of systemic therapy.
Specific tumor groups by study part, such as NSCLC without AGA or HCC with no prior systemic therapy, mCRC, or HER2-negative gastric/GEJ cancer.
not_for: Intolerance to prior topoisomerase I inhibitor or to an ADC containing one.
Uncontrolled or clinically significant cardiovascular or cerebrovascular disease.
History of leptomeningeal carcinomatosis or carcinomatous meningitis.
Any condition the investigator judges could interfere with consent, participation, or result interpretation.
